KeyTheme: Grow in grace and beware false teachers
Summary: Peter urges believers to grow in godly character and knowledge of Christ, warns against false teachers, and answers scoffers about Christ's return. He closes by pointing to the new heavens and new earth.
Themes: Growth; Knowledge of Christ; False teachers; Christ's return
Purpose: To spur spiritual growth, expose false teaching, and confirm confidence in the Lord's promised return.
Outline: Grow in grace (1); False teachers judged (2); The Day of the Lord (3)
HistoricalContext: Peter's farewell letter, written around AD 67-68 shortly before his martyrdom under Nero.
